requirements.text: Among players with a known position, what is the average age at each position?
How many players are there for each nationality?
For each current NBA team, what is the average number of NBA championships won by its listed players?
Among colleges with more than one player in the league, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by any of its players?
Among players with a known position, what is the total number of MVP awards won at each position?
Among players with at least one NBA championship, what is the most championships won by any player of each nationality?
How many players were drafted in each year after 2010?
For each current NBA team, what is the earliest (lowest) draft pick among its drafted players?
Among players with a known position and at least one Olympic gold medal, what is the average number of Olympic golds at each position?
For each college, how many of its players have won at least one NBA championship?
Among players with at least one FIBA World Cup title, what is the total number of FIBA titles for each current NBA team?
How many players aged 20 to 40 are there for each nationality?
For each city that hosts an NBA team, what is the most championships won by any team there?
How many teams founded before 1970 are based in each city?
How many championships has each owner’s team(s) won in total?
Among teams with at least one championship, what is the average number of championships for teams in each city?
What is the average owner age for each nationality?
Among owners who acquired their team in 2000 or later, what is the earliest acquisition year for each nationality?
What is the average city population for each state?

denormalized:dc23a0cc2471.description: One relation containing the union of workload-required symbols.

snowflake:a1276b465861.description: Entity relations linked along workload-referenced relationships.

star:f53e4075dea0.description: Star centered on the most workload-referenced entity 'player'.

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position, what is the average age at each position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", AVG("t0"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."position" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many players are there for each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each current NBA team, what is the average number of NBA championships won by its listed players?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", AVG("t0"."nba_championships_won") AS "avg_player_championships"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among colleges with more than one player in the league, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by any of its players?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."player_college", MAX("t0"."mvp_awards") AS "max_mvp_awards"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."player_college"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position, what is the total number of MVP awards won at each position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", SUM("t0"."mvp_awards") AS "sum_mvp_award"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."position" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with at least one NBA championship, what is the most championships won by any player of each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", MAX("t0"."nba_championships_won") AS "max_nba_championships"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."nba_championships_won" >= 1
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many players were drafted in each year after 2010?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."year", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."year" > 2010
GROUP BY "t0"."year"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each current NBA team, what is the earliest (lowest) draft pick among its drafted players?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", MIN("t0"."draft_pick") AS "min_player_draft_pick"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position and at least one Olympic gold medal, what is the average number of Olympic golds at each position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", AVG("t0"."gold_medals") AS "avg_gold_medals"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE ("t0"."position" IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."gold_medals" >= 1)
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each college, how many of its players have won at least one NBA championship?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."player_college", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."nba_championships_won" >= 1
GROUP BY "t0"."player_college"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with at least one FIBA World Cup title, what is the total number of FIBA titles for each current NBA team?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t3"."name", SUM("t0"."has_fiba_world_cup_title") AS "sum_player_fiba_titles"
FROM "team" AS "t3"
JOIN "player" AS "t0" ON "t0"."team_name" = "t3"."name"
WHERE "t0"."has_fiba_world_cup_title" >= 1
GROUP BY "t3"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many players aged 20 to 40 are there for each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE ("t0"."age" >= 20 AND "t0"."age" <= 40)
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each city that hosts an NBA team, what is the most championships won by any team there?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", MAX("t0"."nba_championships") AS "max_team_championships"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."league" = 'NBA'
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many teams founded before 1970 are based in each city?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t1"."name", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "city" AS "t1"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."based_in" = "t1"."name"
WHERE "t3"."founded_year" < 1970
GROUP BY "t1"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many championships has each owner’s team(s) won in total?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", SUM("t0"."championships") AS "sum_team_championships"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among teams with at least one championship, what is the average number of championships for teams in each city?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", AVG("t0"."championships") AS "avg_team_championships"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."championships" > 0
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: What is the average owner age for each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t2"."nationality", AVG("t2"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "owner" AS "t2"
GROUP BY "t2"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among owners who acquired their team in 2000 or later, what is the earliest acquisition year for each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", MIN("t0"."year_acquired") AS "min_year_acquired"
FROM "workload_flat" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."year_acquired" >= 2000
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: What is the average city population for each state?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t1"."state", AVG("t1"."population") AS "avg_population"
FROM "city" AS "t1"
GROUP BY "t1"."state"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among cities with more than one million people, what is the highest GDP in each state?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t1"."state", MAX("t1"."gdp") AS "max_gdp"
FROM "city" AS "t1"
WHERE "t1"."population" > 1000000
GROUP BY "t1"."state"
